backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with user profiles, questions, tests, sessions, comments, suggestions, and leaderboard types, plus authorization and storage mixins and initial state maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a frontend change wiring React Query hooks to backend profile methods with affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: High-level summaries of multiple frontend files describing their behavior, UI purpose, and implementation details.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring MathJax and loading the main React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling routing, authentication, profile setup flow, view persistence, SEO tags, and activation overlay logic.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Empty file with no implementation content.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment interface for questions with fetch, post, and delete operations and admin controls.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying platform attribution, disclaimer, and responsive layout text.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header managing auth state, view switching, and mobile/desktop menus.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Displays overall leaderboard with rank badges, current-user highlighting, and loading state.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Renders MathJax-formatted math content and re-typesets on content or theme changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Empty placeholder component for per-test result PDF export.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Empty placeholder component for per-test score-only PDF export.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Dialog for creating a user profile with form validation and API submission.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Empty placeholder component for question details dialog.
Filterable, searchable question list with selection, deletion, and admin-only controls.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Empty placeholder component for result list PDF export.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog allowing admins to schedule test start and end times with validation and submission.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Provides WhatsApp and Telegram share buttons that open platform share URLs and display toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Displays and manages user suggestions with loading, error states, deletion, and moderation UI.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: Allows users to submit feedback with character limits, validation, and submission status handling.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Empty placeholder file for user management functionality.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Shows a fullscreen loading overlay when a view is being activated based on context state.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: Prompts users to subscribe on YouTube and verifies subscription before unlocking tests.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing view activation state with timeout handling and helper functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Determines user role using cached bootstrap data and backend reconciliation with admin detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking. Includes helper functions for creating AuthClient instances and accessing the context via a hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and updating user profiles, roles, and test data via an actor, with helpers for converting between backend and local profile formats. Includes mutations with cache invalidation and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS layers and defines extensive light and dark theme variables, global styles, and solid overlay behavior for Radix components. Ensures consistent background, border, and overlay styling app-wide.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app by rendering App within QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider. Initializes React Query and imports global CSS.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with sections describing the platform’s story, mission, and purpose, signaling view activation on mount. Uses various UI components and icons for layout and styling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Empty file placeholder for an admin panel page.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Displays the dashboard with user profile, role, and test config fetching, handling loading states and activation. Shows a banner, welcome text, backend-in-progress notice, suggestions, and share buttons.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component showing hero content, YouTube promo, and navigation, with login handling and view activation on mount.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the test results page.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the test-taking interface.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: Defines local TypeScript interfaces and enums for user profiles, test attempts, questions, tests, comments, and leaderboard entries.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Empty placeholder for PDF export utilities.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: Provides localStorage-based helpers to persist and retrieve user roles for faster UI rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: SessionStorage helpers to persist and restore the user's last viewed app screen for refresh-safe navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with extended theme colors, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, issues, and feature requests related to backend user profile support and frontend integration.
